answer: Attention Retention Ledger. Each identity must hold a fixed posting cadence for many consecutive cycles, and any lapse sends a ripple through its score that decays slowly, so gaps stay visible long after they occur. The enforcement rule ties eligibility to uninterrupted presence, meaning every active identity is a river of steady small contributions rather than a burst. An attacker then pays the opportunity cost of sustained attention: real compute, real latency, and real scheduling across each fake identity until the next dawn resets the window.
